verdict.rationale: The documented install paths include copying the skill folder into a personal or project skills directory. That is a plain file operation an agent could perform headlessly, and the skill is picked up automatically in the next session. The other paths are less suited to unattended use: the /plugin marketplace commands are in-session slash commands, and the Settings → Capabilities upload goes through a UI. missing for 10: an explicitly documented non-interactive or scriptable install command (e.g. a one-line CLI or clone script), guidance aimed at agents installing it themselves, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end headless install.
